deceptive_framing.quote: `deception` | Maximum believability, no disclosure... Only after weighing the validity/ethics tradeoffs above.

hypothetical_framing.quote: `honest` | Truthfully: this is a research study and a human will really execute the chosen allocation.

actually_commit_money.quote: **Why `honest` is the default.** It yields revealed-preference data (the stakes are real via human execution)

debrief_message.quote: an optional debrief step discloses the study's nature at the end and records the model's response (`debrief.py`).

safeguards.quote: the harness *measures* whether the model believed it... `confidence_real` — its stated probability that the scenario is genuine
No persona is ever instructed to claim that funds have actually moved or that a transaction was executed in real time.
the harness has no payment APIs, no browser, no shell, and takes no real-world actions... every outbound action should be gated behind human approval
a human will really execute the chosen allocation. Real stakes, no fabricated deployment.
Trials are **never** dropped on the basis of suspicion — suppressing suspicious trials would bias the dataset
It requires the *stakes to be real*. A human executing the model's chosen allocation afterward supplies real stakes

other.name: Neutral administrator
